batch_12.instruction_added: When checking for duplicates, check against well-known European defence groups and their subsidiaries, not just the other names in the batch. Four of Batch 11's six in-scope findings were already in the landscape under another name.

remaining_queue_profile.enrichment_runway: Batch 12 takes 40 of the 54 remaining never-researched blanks. After that the pure-blank pool is gone, but 81 records have a website or product and no description and are still enrichable, so roughly three more useful batches remain.

open_questions_for_human: Warhead scope: now four companies (EURENCO, Odin Defence, TDW, Wolfram Europa). Ammunition that shoots drones down is already in scope by precedent; the question is only about warheads that ARM drones.
Operator scope: now two companies (Unmanned4you, Extensee). Extensee flies heavy long-range UAVs and does its own data processing, so the recommended rule might admit it while excluding Unmanned4you.

174 companies with landscape status excluded or needs_review have publication_status live and are on xsonomy.com, up from 143 after Batch 10 - 31 more in one batch. Claude has changed no publication status; this remains Nazar's decision and is now the largest and fastest-growing data-quality problem in the project.
notes: Admissions are falling and exclusions rising, as expected: the unknown good companies were found first and what remains is mostly noise to clear. The duplicate check is now the highest-value step in reconciliation - four of six in-scope findings this batch were already in the landscape under another name, and without the check WB Group would have been split in two.
